notes.title: Graphical improvements, bug fixes, and Spanish support!
notes.notes:
Hi all! In this most recent update, We've done a major overhaul of the shaders, and lighting for interiors has been vastly improved. In addition to this, there are some bug fixes, and we now have official support for Spanish!
[img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/27653193/1d5804f757e6c42c5da8d8cf3f5b2c19bce9faa2.jpg[/img]

notes.title: Fan Translations, Chinese, and Patch 1.04
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! We are elated to report the release has gone splendidly! And hearing about all of your experiences has been very rewarding. A few days ago, I opened up the ability for the community to make [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/585840/discussions/0/135508489636847917/]fan translations[/url] and some amazingly kind folks have been translating the game to different languages so more people can enjoy it. Because of user [url=http://steamcommunity.com/id/annsenly/]Annsen Lee[/url], Chinese is now a supported language!

Additionally, I've made a few updates attempting to address some of the more common issues people were having, as well as fixed some bugs.
[list]
    [*]made it possible to exit the chime game before completing it (however you still eventually need to complete it before leaving the forest)
    [*]fixed issues where non-english languages showed the wrong dialogue sometimes.
    [*]removed bug where is says "its almost time..." when you beat the game
[/list]
